mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_snapshot(user_id,username,real_name,dept_id,dept_name,role_codes_json,enabled,source_version) VALUES(#{user.userId},#{user.username},#{user.realName},#{user.deptId,jdbcType=BIGINT},#{user.deptName},#{rolesJson},#{user.enabled},#{user.authVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username=IF(VALUES(source_version)>=source_version,VALUES(username),username), real_name=IF(VALUES(source_version)>=source_version,VALUES(real_name),real_name), dept_id=IF(VALUES(source_version)>=source_version,VALUES(dept_id),dept_id), dept_name=IF(VALUES(source_version)>=source_version,VALUES(dept_name),dept_name), role_codes_json=IF(VALUES(source_version)>=source_version,VALUES(role_codes_json),role_codes_json), enabled=IF(VALUES(source_version)>=source_version,VALUES(enabled),enabled), source_version=GREATEST(source_version,VALUES(source_version))
